study: vortex128 (track 1, round 3): the fed-vortex world's level-2 selection signal at 128^2

design128.source: results/main128_{sel,neu}.json (run.py main ARM 6 440 2, then resumed with run.py main ARM 6 600 2 in chain3.sh)
design128.note: designer ensemble(6, seed=2): keys independent of the round-2 pilot (ensemble(1, seed 0)) and checker (ensemble(1, seed 1))

timing.note: overflow rows = (raw_overflow_ticks, kept_overflow_ticks, raw_peak, kept_peak) per member; main128 includes the extension from tick 440 to 600 (resumed from the saved carry)

per_seed.note: W1 = ticks [100, 300) (t 500-1495), W2 = ticks [300, 440] (t 1500-2200), W3 = ticks [441, 600] (t 2205-3000, the extension); first majority = first tick whose centred 9-tick running mean of s_b > 0.5 (None = never)

paired_sel_minus_neu.note: 6 seeds; p from a paired t-test, the exact sign-flip permutation test (64 patterns), the exact Wilcoxon signed-rank test and the sign test

paired_with_earlier_seeds.note: adds the round-2 pilot seed (W1 and W2) and the checker's seed 1 (W1 only; it stopped at t 1500)

diff_s_b_by_t.note: mean, SE and positive count of sel - neu over the 6 seeds

mutations.note: the accumulated float64 time is 300.0000000000171 at native step 15000, so the first mutation acts at the labelling step (t 300), not at t 350

design.source: results/area64_{sel,neu}.json (members 0-3), area64x_* and box64x_* (members 4-7); per-box members 0-3 from ../vortex_world/results/pilot_H64.npz
design.note: same initial conditions and keys per member at both rates (ensemble(8, seed 0) member j = the round-2 pilot's member j for j < 4); mut_dt 200 at 64^2 = the 128^2 rate per unit area (9 vs 38/4 = 9.5 events per 64^2 of area by t 2200)

identical_until_tick.note: level-2 rows equal to the round-2 per-box rows to tick 60; the first per-box mutation acts at t 300

neutral_N_identical.note: with eps = 0 the labels are passive, so the vortex count does not depend on the mutation schedule

design.note: c = (V0 - Ve)/(V0 - Vu); OLS on the last w level-2 values, leave-one-seed-out with twins held out together; 'branch' = fitted on branch rows (the round-2 definition), 'traj' = fitted on main trajectories, 'traj_t' = 'traj' plus the tick, 'traj_slope' = 'traj' plus the 20-tick mean and 40-tick slope; cchg = (V_change - Ve)/(V_change - Vu) with V_change = var(y(t+h) - y(t)): closure against persistence plus the mean drift; horizons in 5-time-unit ticks; a linear predictor, so c is a lower bound

bootstrap_pooled_w2.note: 16th and 84th percentiles over seed resamples (draws with < 3 distinct seeds dropped)

checker_seed_heldout.note: analyse.closure_boot holds out by slot j, so when a seed is drawn twice its copy stays in the training set; recomputed with every copy of the held-out seed removed (same 200 draws, same rng seed 0). Bands move by <= 0.02 (traj) and <= 0.05 (cchg).

closure64_recomputed.note: c_branch_w2 reproduces the round-2 checker's 'twins held out together' numbers exactly

value.selection_128_settled: yes: kind b's share is higher in the favoured arm in 6/6 new seeds in each window (t 500-1495: +0.15; t 1500-2200: +0.37; t 2205-3000: +0.44), the exact sign-flip p is 0.031 in each, the smallest value 6 seeds can give, and 8/8 and 7/7 with the two earlier seeds (p 0.008, 0.016); settled for this parameter point only (eps 0.2 vs 0, sigma_a 0.005, mut_dt 50, tracker threshold 0.06, world_seed 0); the three windows are the same 6 runs, not independent replicates, and in W1 one seed's difference is +0.0045
value.majority: favoured arm: kind b majority at t 1055-1545 (6/6 seeds); neutral twin: 2/6 seeds by t 2200 (1705, 2035), 5/6 by t 3000, but transient (share of W3 ticks in majority 0-0.14 except one seed at 0.93); the round-2 'neutral never' was a 2-seed observation
value.box_size_hypothesis: supported for the mutation-rate part only (the test changes mutation per unit area, and the first mutation time 300 -> 400, not other box-size effects): at 64^2 with mutation per unit area (mut_dt 200) the late paired difference is +0.51 (8/8, p 0.008) against +0.06 (5/8, p 0.45) at the per-box rate; the favoured arm's late share rises 0.58 -> 0.87 (7/8 members, p 0.016); the neutral twin's falls 0.52 -> 0.36 (7/8, p 0.07); difference in differences +0.45, 8/8 members, exact sign-flip p 0.008 (checker)
value.closure_128: c for s_b stays >= 0.94 to 160 t and N >= 0.59 (c_traj_w2 / c_branch_w2), but this is persistence of a slow, low-noise variable across a heterogeneous sample (persistence alone gives s_b 0.85-0.99); against persistence plus the mean drift, a pooled linear level-2 predictor explains none of the s_b change (cchg -0.32 to +0.05) although the oracle shows 51-56% of it is predictable at 40-160 t; within the favoured arm alone cchg is 0.19-0.24 at 20-160 t (against that arm's own drift); adding the true eps as a regressor to the pooled predictor lifts the pooled s_b cchg only to -0.32..+0.10 (+0.09 to +0.19 at 80-160 t, checker), so eps carries a small part of the predictable change and most of the oracle-predictable 51-56% is not reached by a linear level-2 predictor even with eps known
value.E4: still not established as a world-versus-world claim: this study settles the level-2 selection signal and gives a rough level-2 closure at 128^2, but the gliders comparison remains unmatched (level 2 vs level 1, no I1, linear predictors, 48 branch points)

decisions.source: results/analysis.json (paired128, paired128_with_earlier_seeds, sel128/neu128, area64, closure128); the numbers are repeated with their own sources in selection128, area64 and closure128

value: closure rests on 4 branch points per run (48 pooled, R = 3, 144 rows); bootstrap 16-84% for N at 160 t is 0.47-0.71 (traj w2; seed-level resampling with every copy of a resampled seed held out, checker) and the 16-84% band of the pooled cchg for s_b includes 0 at 20, 80 and 160 t, sits just above 0 at 40 t (0.004-0.15) and is negative at 5-10 t
the closure V0 pools the rise of s_b across t 500-2000 and both arms, which is why c is high; cchg is the more honest number and it is noisy because V_change - Vu is small (s_b: 0.0002-0.0024)
neutral-arm cchg for s_b is negative (-2.2 to -0.1): within the neutral arm the s_b change is mostly noise (Vu/V_change 0.54-0.91) and a fitted predictor does worse than persistence plus drift

at 64^2 the first per-box mutation acts at t 300 (the labelling step, from accumulated float time), the first per-area one at t 400; per-area members also see 9 vs the 128^2 38/4 = 9.5 events per 64^2 of area by t 2200

the task text estimated 1.1 CPU-hours per arm-seed pair to t 2200; the measured cost is 0.53 s per member-tick, 0.13 CPU-hours per pair, so the budget went to 6 seeds, an extension to t 3000 and 8 seeds at 64^2

most tracked vortices carry mixed labels: in W2-W3 78-85% (sel) and 61-84% (neu) of present slots have frac_b in 0.2-0.8, 21-41% in 0.4-0.6, so s_b is a threshold count that amplifies small shifts in label share; at 64^2 (round-2 level-0 snapshots, t >= 1500) the |om| weighting of frac_b hardly moves the arm gap (field label-b share gap 0.030 |om|-weighted vs 0.029 area-weighted), but this was not checkable at 128^2 (snapshots deleted) (checker)

value.what: an eps-inference exam pilot at 128^2: eps drawn from a prior (5 values in [0, 0.3]) x 4 seeds to t 2200, 4 branch points x R 3 x 32 ticks each; score s_b and N at 40-160 t for prior-mean, inferred-eps and true-eps predictors (the harness toy's gap was too small: 0.83-0.93 vs 0.94)
value.gliders_member_tick_equivalents: 0.53 s / (0.13-0.16 s) = 3.3-4.1 gliders member-ticks per vortex member-tick at 128^2, i.e. 55-67k gliders member-ticks
value.gpu_hours: unmeasured (GPU throughput still unmeasured for both worlds)
value.then: a matched closure comparison with gliders (same level, I1, best-of predictor) to decide E4: about 6 seeds x 2 arms x 16 branch points x R 4 x 32 ticks = 24.6k member-ticks, 3.6 CPU-hours for the vortex branch rollouts only; the level-0 snapshots were deleted and run.py saves only 4, so regenerating the 6 x 2 main runs to t 2200 adds 5,280 member-ticks (0.8 CPU-hours), and the gliders side of the matched comparison is not costed (checker)
